verdict.rationale: Jan is a local-LLM desktop app, so recommending a model that fits the user's hardware and task before download is a fair question for it. The evidence only covers downloading models from HuggingFace, searching the Hub by model ID, importing GGUF files, and pausing or resuming downloads. Nothing shows an assistant or feature that recommends models based on hardware or task.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
